summary.intent: Resolve final round of automated PR review comments (Copilot + CodeRabbit) on PR #392, then fix a release gate gap where test-only commits to main could merge a release-please PR without re-verifying E2E tests, and consolidate E2E change detection into a single orchestrator workflow.
summary.outcome: All 3 review threads on PR #392 resolved with fixes (fixture overwrite guard, missing faro_enabled field, page.isClosed() guard). PR #394 created and reviewed to fix the release gate gap via a new ci-e2e.yml orchestrator that consolidates change detection for both web and desktop E2E, plus a retrigger mechanism that re-runs the release gate after E2E completes on main.

repo: Release gate (release-gate.yml) only enforces E2E verification for release-please branches by default — non-release PRs auto-pass the 'Verify E2E Passed' check, making it a no-op gate for feature/test PRs

test: and chore: commit types do not trigger release-please to update the changelog or re-run the release PR gate, creating a window where stale green checks can allow a release to merge without verifying latest code
desktop-e2e.yml already used dorny/paths-filter for change detection before this session; e2e.yml did not
apps/desktop/src-tauri does NOT have its own Cargo.lock — root Cargo.lock covers all workspace crates
Committed E2E fixture files live in tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/ — createTestMediaFile/createTestImageFile cleanup could delete them if the test name matched a fixture name
staging-journey-timing.json baseline requires a faro_enabled: true metadata field
cleanup-helpers.ts page.evaluate() in teardown needs a page.isClosed() guard to avoid errors when the page closes before teardown runs

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, createTestBinaryFile all needed a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard to prevent cleanup from deleting actual fixture files
Missing faro_enabled: true field in metadata — required by the verification plan
page.evaluate() in teardown must be guarded with page.isClosed() check
jq // empty on empty string causes parse error; log message incorrectly said 'Web E2E' when polling ci-e2e.yml
Desktop patterns initially missing Cargo.lock; also fetch-depth: 1 insufficient for dorny/paths-filter diff — needs fetch-depth: 0
gh run rerun on retrigger job uses stale GITHUB_SHA; release-gate diff should target origin/main not HEAD

workflow: dorny/paths-filter requires fetch-depth: 0 on actions/checkout to have the before commit available for accurate diffs
gh run rerun preserves original GITHUB_SHA — any path diff logic in a retriggered workflow must reference origin/main explicitly rather than HEAD
Reusable workflows inherit the vars context from the calling repository automatically — no extra configuration needed
gh api with --field (integer) vs --raw-field (string) matters for in_reply_to when replying to review comments via REST
CodeRabbit has per-hour rate limits that cause ~23 minute cooldown periods before re-review

friction: CodeRabbit was rate-limited for ~23 minutes, requiring extended polling with background tasks before its review arrived

Solving the wrong problem twice on the release gate issue — first proposed adding PR-level E2E triggers, then proposed re-triggering after merge, before understanding the real issue was stale checks on release-please PRs
gh api reply calls hit network timeouts requiring retries
Background polling spawned too many overlapping tasks, creating noise in task notifications
PR #393 was created for the wrong fix and had to be closed immediately
open_items: ci-e2e.yml retrigger-release-gate job behavior on re-runs still uses potentially stale context — the origin/main diff fix addresses detection but the broader re-run semantics should be validated in practice
